hints: To find 1/10 of a number, divide it by 10.
Dividing by 10 moves the decimal point 1 place to the left. Do this to ₱350.

solution.methodName: Change the percent to an easy fraction

steps.why: 10 out of 100 is the same as 1 out of 10.
To divide a number that ends in 0 by 10, drop the last 0. 350 becomes 35.

trapNotes.₱3.50: This divides by 100, which gives 1%. For 10%, divide by 10.
trapNotes.₱340: This subtracts 10 from 350. 10% means 1/10 of the amount, so divide by 10.
trapNotes.₱70: This divides by 5, which gives 20%. For 10%, divide by 10.
